Senthil Sukumar

LinkedIn · GitHub



About
Thanks for stopping by.
My name is Senthil (SEN-thil).
I was born and raised in Singapore, and call California my home. I currently live in Seoul together with my wife and daughter for work.
I’m a seasoned Business Intelligence and Analytics leader with over a decade of experience at big companies like Google and Coupang. I’ve worked in all sorts of industries such as tech, aviation, e-commerce, video streaming and advertising where I developed, launched and/or scaled almost all facets of enterprise data ops such as:

Helpful analytics and data engineering teams
System observability and monitoring
Data capture and warehousing systems
Production-grade data pipelines
Metric and data governance
Product and user analytics
Business and revenue forecasts
Sales and Revenue Operations




Projects




 



Shipping Data Automation (prepared for SpaceX)

SpaceX · California, USA · 2024

I prepared a presentation on an E2E (end-to-end) shipping data automation project I led at Wing that decreased the time it took to make replenishment decisions from an average of 2 weeks to 30 minutes (-99.9%) for SpaceX as part of a job interview. I was offered the role, but decided to join Coupang instead (my current company).

SQL 101 Bootcamp

Google · Singapore · 2019

My career began with SQL, from when I first dabbled in it in college, to when I started teaching it to professionals on weekends for quick money after I graduated, and all through my working years. It’s become part of my analytical toolkit and one of the few ways I enter my “flow state”. When I joined Google in 2017, within a few months I was continuing to spread the gospel of SQL and holding business analysis bootcamps for Strategy/Account Managers and Analysts. This is the public version of my General Assembly bootcamp slides and exercises.
